outcome: Anthropometric indices of newborns (weight, length, head circumference)
cohort: 195 pregnant women who delivered at 22 Bahman Hospital in Khaf, Iran, in 2021.
finding: Higher levels of COVID-19 stress in pregnant women were associated with a higher rate of cesarean deliveries and lower APGAR scores and anthropometric indices in newborns.
mod_finding: Pregnant women who underwent cesarean sections exhibited significantly higher levels of COVID-19-related stress compared to those who had natural deliveries (p<0.001).
birth_weight: Neonatal weight was negatively correlated with maternal COVID-19 stress.
